{"consolidated_memory":"**Message Redelivery Issues in worker/queue/consumer.py — Two Separate Occasions**

The background jobs consumer has experienced message redelivery bugs requiring targeted fixes on two distinct occasions:

**Occasion 1: [2026-03-13]**
- Component: worker/queue/consumer.py
- Trigger: deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- Reproduction: kill the worker mid-batch and restart it
- Root cause: naive datetime compared against an aware datetime (timezone mismatch at boundary)
- Signal: same message id handled more than once
- Performance impact: cold start dropped 32 percent, to 536 ms
- Fix: made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
- PR #1275 on branch fix/message-redelivery-1

**Occasion 2: [2026-07-21]**
- Component: worker/queue/consumer.py (same location)
- Trigger: only on the staging read replica
- Reproduction: kill the worker mid-batch and restart it
- Root cause: missing Unicode normalisation before hashing (message id hash collision)
- Signal: same message id handled more than once
- Performance impact: job duration reduced from 7 hours to 24 minutes
- Fix: normalised to NFC ahead of the digest
- PR #3299 on branch fix/message-redelivery-3

Both incidents occurred in the same corner of worker/queue/consumer.py; context carried over from earlier message redelivery work in that component."}
